wk_10_27gu.body:
The Leader of the Shipwright guild in the Zotov Sector. 

The Chairman came from nothing. Born to working class family on Leyev he clawed, scraped, connived, and cheated their way to the top of the Guild.

Under Ozol's watch the Guild has risen higher than it ever has before.
wk_10_27gu.title: Chairman Ozol

wk_10_73go.body: Until recently the sparse Ossite deposits on aeglos were not worth extracting. But with new space fracking tech the planet has drawn in investment from private extraction firms. The planetary governor has been careful not to declare for any faction yet, but this neutrality may not hold for long
wk_10_73go.title: Aeglos

wk_11_6zdw.body:
Dyne was once an unwavering ally to gorb. The planet has fallen into a local civil war since the planets Duke was killed in the galactic civil war along with the system's entirely fleet.

The potential heirs now vie for control in a war that covers much of the planet.

The Ossite deposits here are rich but the ongoing war makes export impossible.
wk_11_6zdw.title: Dyne

wk_14_6o21.body: A trade hub that mostly serves as a highway for imperial Ossite on its way from vladir to the imperial core.
wk_14_6o21.title: Yelftin

wk_156_gt7t.body:
A comfortable mid-tier processing world, refining crude piped in from the smaller Flubbadite fields.

It is known for its deadly flora and fauna that lurk outside the gates of its settlements.
wk_156_gt7t.title: Hupp

wk_157_o8ei.body:
Named for the perpetual haze thrown off its surface refineries, Ashfall is a solidly prosperous industrial world of mid-size cities and well-paid guild labor. 

Its refinery unions are influential enough that the Flubbadite Council courts them directly.
wk_157_o8ei.title: Ashfall

wk_158_kxa7.body:
(formerly Imperial Garrison Station Zotov-9)

This is the 11th Fleet's forward operating base, informally renamed by its own crews.
Technically it is Imperial property. Functionally it is Zakar's personal seat of power in the sector.
it boasts one of the largest shipyards in the sector.
wk_158_kxa7.title: Zakar's Station

wk_160_7hbb.body:
A mid-sector world seized under "stabilization" authority after a Gorbulon-Flubbadite border dispute turned violent. Now it is permanently garrisoned by the 11th Fleet
This is the first Zotov world to answer to Zakar alone, and a template for more.
wk_160_7hbb.title: Cordage Reach

wk_16_sm89.body:
The Heir the the Gorbulon Throne.

Gorbin is disillusioned with the old way. he has seen that the Flubbadite reformers have built in one generation what it took the gorbulons 10 to build. This attitude has not won him any friends in the gorbulon court, a place dominated by the old aristocracy

Many gorbulons would rather not see him ascend the throne.
wk_16_sm89.title: Gorbin Glu

wk_18_4cai.body:
Every faction has set of ever changing modifiers that affect their action rolls and combat shifts. these are listed in your Modifiers tab.

Often the only way to achieve a difficult task is to start by trying easier tasks to get positive modifiers that affect the challenging task.

For example: Root out the Guerillas on Dyne is a very difficult action. You will not succeed. so you can take an action to infiltrate the rebel army giving you a new mod that helps with military actions against the rebels. and thus chain actions together
wk_18_4cai.title: Modifers and Shifts

wk_18_4qym.body:
Zakar's dutiful #2. Petra Fought with Zakar in the Makovy Sector and is his most competent subordinate. Time will tell how far her personal loyalty to Zakar will go. 

Outside of work, she's an ardent follower of Kronkite β-Ball. Her favorite team is the Primag Photons, and she's very excited to see how they do in the Kronkite β-Ball Sector Grand Tournament.
wk_18_4qym.title: Vice Admiral Petra

wk_192_vbzs.body:
Brilliant, magnetic, unburdened by sentiment. Zakar is the Most famous man in the empire. He made his name putting down rebellion in the Makovy Sector winning a chain of 4 stunning, if costly victories over the rebels. No individual is more responsible for the end of the civil war than he is. 

He Now commands the 11th Fleet and is quietly building a power base independent of the Imperial chain of command.


"It is over marquis, for I have already depicted you as the rotund soyjack and myself as the purple-cloaked chad"
wk_192_vbzs.title: Admiral Zakar

wk_193_iltz.body:
The galaxy runs on Ossite. Every hyperdrive core in the galaxy burns it, refined down from the raw crude into the volatile fuel that lets ships punch through to FTL.

The Zotov sector has the largest deposits of ossite in the galaxy and control of this precious resource bring wealth and power to those who wield it
wk_193_iltz.title: Ossite

wk_194_3ygo.body:
The Invention of the Ossite Drive Marked a strange point in the history of communication. 

A Radio signal from Gorb wouldn't reach Ashfall for a decade. So the Zotov sector, like the rest of the Empire, abandoned it generations ago in favor of the Courier Protocol: message traffic carried by small, stripped-down FTL vessels, skiffs, built for nothing but speed and a data core.

The Speed of communication outpaces the speed of a by less than an order of magnitude.

This shapes everything about how the sector operates. Fleet-Commander Zakar's authority over the 11th Fleet exists largely because Imperial oversight is always a courier-run behind events.
wk_194_3ygo.title: FTL Communication (Skiffs)

wk_195_gz3t.body:
The Galactic Empire has just weathered the greatest crisis in its history. A rebellion in the Makovy sector brought the empire to the brink of collapse. The ensuing civil war decimated imperial and rebel forces alike. In the end the imperial forces and their vassals prevailed at great cost, Imperial power has receded across the galaxy and many local lords vie for wealth and power in the far corners of the galaxy.

The Zotov sector avoided the mass death and destruction of the rebellion, but many of its fleets were ravaged fighting for the empire far from home during the conflict. The sector is officially ruled by the House of Gorb on behalf of the empire.

But all is not well for the Gorbulons. Their own fleet was severely diminished during the war and they are increasingly relying on the ships of their unruly vassals to fill out their fleet. Seeing this weakness, the council of Flubb, historically one of the Gorbulons most powerful vassals, chafe under this state of affairs. Conflict seems inevitable.

The Sectors oldest inhabitants, The children of Luuk. see an opportunity in the power vacuum to gain more autonomy and spread their ancient faith across the stars. 

In the midst of this brewing conflict the Empire sent its most famous citizen, the war hero Admiral Zakar to administer the sector and bring peace. But the Admiral is as ambitious as he is cunning and with the 11th imperial fleet under his personal command he stands poised to make a play for power himself.
wk_195_gz3t.title: The Zotov Sector Today

wk_196_9d0c.body:
A heavily trafficked Gorbulon waystation. It used to be that every convoy bound for the capital passed through its lanes, and the Vega Reserve fleet keeps a standing watch here.
Now Zakar's twin Jump gates at New Fountain and Zakar's Station have diverted the flow of many Ossite haulers, cutting into Vega's profits.

This is Ossite's last stop before it is shipped to the imperial core.

The Planet was once the site of a great siege in the earliest days of Gorbulon consolidation, and it still bears the monumental tunnel networks, redoubts, and anti-starship cannon emplacements.
wk_196_9d0c.title: Vega Gate

wk_1_0w9g.body:
The former militia leader who swore to fight against mob rule, he was personally appointed Governor of Bobursk by Admiral Zakar of the 11th fleet. 

Alexx Kimble is the galaxy's greatest Zakar fan. 

Alexx Kimble has posters of Zakar in his bedroom. And statues of Zakar in his private residence. And Zakar branded kitchenware. 

Alexx Kimble, surprisingly, has implemented popular reforms on Bobursk and maintains 65% popularity according to the Imperial Standard News. 

Alexx Kimble is an extremely stable individual.
wk_1_0w9g.title: Governor Alexx Kimble

wk_1_1rwf.body:
Rongus spent his youth working in the shipyard docks, the soft hum of his dockyard exoskeleton powering every slab of spacefleet steel he placed into a Crubb-class assembly rig. With natural affinity for the machinery that let him carry 3 tons of metal with a single-hand, he was the obvious choice to test-pilot a modded dockyard exo to be presented to Pargulon as a gift after the former requisitioned an entire fleet. As a result, the two became fast friends and ultimately, Rongus would choose to leave his job in the shipyard docks to serve as Pargulon's companion, right-hand, and advisor. Though there are whispers that Rongus and Pargulon were more than friends, the history books will probably record them as "just roommates". 

Three-quarters of a decade after first meeting Pargulon, Rongus would fail to stop a Bastenich from scratching Pargulon. After a fierce battle which left Pargulon incapacitated, the beast slain, and Rongus horribly disfigured and without sight in his left eye, he would deliver his companion to the sweet darkness of cryo-sleep. Though he failed to save Pargulon, Rongus has sought respite from survivor's guilt by dedicating the remainder of his life to raising Pargulon's children, Phorbius and Kirinquaz. In particular, Rongus has formed a strong bond with Phorbius. If there's anyone who could be credited with providing the outsider's perspective and guidance that has allowed for Phorbius's meteoric rise and subsequent reforms of the system, it's Rongus. In deference, Phorbius asked to take Rongus's last name.
wk_1_1rwf.title: Rongus Flub

wk_1_3ik6.body:
Primag is a dense jungle world that is only inhabited sparely along its equator.

It hosts the largest undeclared shipyard in the sector. Officially, It only turns out civilian grade hulls. The shipyard is managed by a wing of the shipwright guild council. And they have been careful to avoid angering any of the militant factions in the sector. But the planet may not be able to sit in the fence any longer
wk_1_3ik6.title: Primag

wk_1_4fsu.body:
Chief science officer of the 11th fleet. She graduated top of her class from Zimulvya University right at the onset of the Black Pandemic. Her work at developing an effective antidote to this terrorist bioweapon earned her much praise, which was short lived due to the onset of the Makovy Crisis and subsequent civil war. There, she volunteered to join an experimental research team working on designing battle-ready prosthetics for wounded soldiers.

Linzhova along with 2 other scientists, is credited with inventing an synthetic blood which was used to save Kizavius Zakar's life after the Yakolev II incident. Since then she has not left his side, constantly monitoring and maintaining the performance of his prosthetics alongside whatever scientific curiosities he throws at her.
wk_1_4fsu.title: Dr. Kalina Linzhova, Lieutenant 1st Class

wk_1_582z.body:
Conquering a planet is a monumental task. it cannot be done quickly. If a world wants to resist you. they will. it will take many turns and many lives to conquer a planet. When possible some form of settlement will serve both parties much better.

If you must Invade a world in full force, there will be a check at the start of each turn determining what percentage of the surface you conquer as well as a check for causing enough damage to meaningfully degrade the infrastructure of the planet.
wk_1_582z.title: Planetary Invasion

wk_1_5cxa.body: Fluent in Gorbanese, Yako, and a handful of exotic and forgotten languages, Gichelle is the glue maintaining House Dorn's social status in Gorbulon and the Zotov Sector at large. She regularly hosts extravagant invite-only parties bankrolled by the Dorn family fortune, while keeping her good-for-nothing husband far, far away from the festivities. A born hostess and entertainer, dignitaries from all across the Zotov Sector make time in their busy schedules to unwind and relax over unforgettable evenings of good food, copious quantities of Luuk's Flight, and grand spectacle. Her greatest shame is that she is infertile and will never be able to produce a legitimate heir for the House Dorn
wk_1_5cxa.title: Gichelle Gorbius, Duke of Dorn

wk_1_6301.body:
People of Dyne, 

It has been two weeks since Gason Gorn's forces were routed at the Battle of Port Yondo. If you're like most of us, the news that the stalemate had broken was likely a relief—it seemed like the turning point in the civil war. It seemed like we might actually live to see the day that the bloodshed stops and that our children might yet come home from the battlefront intact rather than in a pine box. 

But the heavyhanded tactics that Gertrude's forces have used to obtain this victory are despicable and vile. The Committee of Planetary Safety, which residents of Dyne once admired and respected, have now descended en masse into residential and neutral areas of Dyne under the pretense of 'rooting out Gason's forces'. Personally, I had a harrowing experience where a CPS pig kicked down my front door because my husband "looked like a Gason sympathizer". Our eldest child (who thankfully has been off-world in service of the 11th fleet since before the civil war started) was literally schoolmates with Gertrude! Our granddaughter, a wee babe of only four years old, was reduced to tears when a CPS officer ripped her teddy bear in half while looking for "covert communication" devices. She's been plagued by nightmares ever since. Are these really the people we ought to be entrusting our "security" to? 

It's clear that this is not the CPS we were raised to believe in. Left unchecked, I believe that the influence of the CPS (and Gorbulon meddling in Dyne private affairs at large) is likely to lead to an even more miserable state of affairs for what remains of the society of Dyne. Though I must submit this missive anonymously for my own safety, I hope that those on Dyne who see no reason for the senseless brutalization of the civilian populace will join forces in calling for the Liberation of Dyne!

Yours, 
The Voice of the DPLC (Dyne People's Liberation Coalition)
wk_1_6301.title: Statement From The Dyne People's Liberation Coalition (DPLC)

wk_1_6gxa.body:
A series of lies were published yesterday by the so-called Dyne People's Liberation Coalition (DPLC). While many of the falsehoods were so obvious that it pains us to even refute them, it is nonetheless important to show that the CPS has been, and remains, a transparent organization which exists in tandem with all peoples of the Zotov Sector. 

All officers are required to wear body cameras during any and all operations and the claims that a member of the CPS “ripped apart a teddy bear” are completely unfounded. We encourage members of our community to engage critically with the media they consume lest they be swayed by influences who do not have their best interests at heart. 

The Voice of Gorbulon reached out to Garginox Grekky for comment: 

“The DPLC are a bunch of thugs who were murdering each other in the street three weeks ago. Without the swift intervention of the CPS, the people of Dyne would be living in a warzone. CPS is fully committed to a swift transition of power to the rightful heir of Dyne, Gertrude Gorn.” 

We would like to remind our listeners that, as citizens, we have a duty to keep our communities safe and the anonymous tip lines for the CPS and VoG are open and monitored 26 hours a day.
wk_1_6gxa.title: Breaking News: CPS Responds to the Allegations of the DPLC

wk_1_778b.body:
A treacherous system with an unstable binary star system prone to sunbursts and solar flares. Against all odds, there is a small permanent population here on one of the planets due to high concentrations of rare elements needed for spacecraft and electronics manufacturing. 

Mortality rate among residents is very high, but the allure of high paying mining prospects always keeps them coming. 

The volatility of the system makes detecting ships here challenging. Strike craft will likely have to jump blind.
wk_1_778b.title: Bassrender

wk_1_ccsz.body: The Voice of Gorbulon was developed roughly 50 years ago by Grobbulus Gorbo in order to appeal to a pro-Gorbulon audience. Although it has never been proven that Grobbulus is a member of the Inner Council, he nevertheless has a strong relationship with the Grand Marquis. The Voice of Gorbulon has become one of the sector’s most popular news sources and as such, there are Voice of Gorbulon broadcast stations based on all major planets. However, it is well known that Grobbulus is quite old and is currently naming a successor for his media empire. Whoever he chooses will become the next Gorbo of Jorbo.
wk_1_ccsz.title: The Voice of Gorbulon

wk_1_eces.body: Tropical beaches and scenic mountain overlooks dominate the landscape of Oasis. In a sector where heavy industry has destroyed much of the environment on other worlds, Oasis remains a destination for vacationing noble, and well to do citizens. It's also the intergalactic home of the Kronkite β-Ball Sector Grand Tournament, hosted in the open-air Unka Stadium.
wk_1_eces.title: Oasis

wk_1_enlk.body: Rolf is an utterly unremarkable system; with one exception.
wk_1_enlk.title: Rolf

wk_1_fr77.body:
The Rogue Prophet is shrouded in mystery, He holds no lands nor any great wealth, just the devotion of his flock.

To his followers he is the second coming of Luuk. To everyone else, including more moderate members of the church, he is dangerous radical.

While his followers are tolerated in Luukite Space they are despised across the rest of the sector.
wk_1_fr77.title: The Prophet Padishah Marja Böra-Din ibn Börd

wk_1_g3wv.body:
Oh you like sports? You like sports with balls? Do you like wrestling with big strong gender nonspecific individuals while working collaboratively with your team to put that big ball inside a hoop? Well have we got a game for you! 

Taking advantage of ossite artificial gravity generation (and conventional propulsion engines for spectacle!), players navigate THE most convoluted offsides rules imaginable to compete in teams of six to see who can take one Kronkite ball from the floor of the β arena to the hoop at the ceiling in Zotov Sector's hottest sportsball game. 

Points are scored by throwing the ball through the hoop (think basketball, but in 3D) with spectators (not pictured) off to the side of the hexagonal hamster wheel-looking structure.
wk_1_g3wv.title: Kronkite β-Ball

wk_1_h57q.body:
Galagoon runs the illicit sex-trade for all Gorbulon aligned worlds. He can be found on "The Island" of Nakimo. 
 
The existence of Galagoon is known by many, but few openly admit to making his acquaintance. While it would be inaccurate to list him as the most powerful member of the Inner Council, that is only true because nobody is willing to admit how much they rely on his services. 

Galagoon is primarily responsible for servicing the needs and desires of the Marquis and other prominent, well-connected members of Gorbulon society. However, he also works quite closely with [REDACTED] since they both have a vested interest in [REDACTED].
wk_1_h57q.title: Galagoon, The Hoe-server

wk_1_ib5i.body:
The DPLC is a neutral/civilian grassroots movement whose main goal is speaking up against war crimes and atrocities committed by both sides of the Dyne civil war. They represent ordinary citizens—homeowners, businessowners, renters, consumers, mothers, fathers, brothers, sisters, and children who want to see things be resolved peacefully so that life can mostly go back to normal. 

More radical elements of the DPLC not only wish to see an end to conflict on the world, but a complete and total cessation of contact with Gorbulon, especially after witnessing the aftermath of heavy CPS presence on the planet.
wk_1_ib5i.title: Dyne People's Liberation Coalition (DPLC)

wk_1_in66.body:
It is my firm reminder to all parties is that my presence in the Zotov Sector is for the maintenance and health of the Galactic Empire and its tributaries. Emperor Yakolev himself has granted me his personal blessing to enforce his will. As per treatises drafted centuries ago, the Emperor and therefore, I shall respect regional autonomy in this sector as long as we are confident that ossite production continues to be predictable. Entire systems with organized crime operating in the open, drug empires serving as vassal states to regional hegemons, and the violence that occurred on Cordage Reach are all firsthand evidence that such agreements are due for renegotiation, with me serving as the arbiter of who deserves the privilege of partaking in this sector's spoils. 

With that said, any aggression on the 11th Fleet shall be considered as an attack upon the Emperor Himself, and swift punishment shall be inflicted upon all that dare threaten the stability and sanctity of the Empire. 

Admiral Kizavius Zakar
11th Fleet
wk_1_in66.title: Statement Issued by Admiral Zakar of the 11th Fleet after the seizure of Cordage Reach.

wk_1_jcc3.body:
Officially, he is Admiral Zakar's personal steward. Not much is known about this individual other than he only appears in Imperial records after Zakar's recovery following the Yakolev II incident. He is only seen in the presence of Admiral Zakar

He is purported to be Zakar's personal spymaster, but those are only unsubstantiated rumors circulating around Gushky
wk_1_jcc3.title: Lieutenant Syrkyski

wk_1_k4vh.body:
A nasty mishap with an early prototype of what is now the modern FTL drive invented nearly forty generations ago released enough energy to crack Tommon's homeworld in two, nearly annihilating the population. Ever since, the survivors have eek'd out cold, miserable lives on various satellite moons of Tommon while slowing rebuilding their civilization. Recent reports indicate that Tommon's biosphere has finally become inhabitable once again—and that the powerful explosion which caused Tommon's downfall millenia ago has exposed vast veins rich with Ossite deep within the planet's core.

Largely as a result of the devastation caused by the Disaster that befell the world; the system has largely converted to a radical form of Luukism that Rejects the extraction and use of Ossite. But the chance to lift the system out of poverty entices many inhabitants.
wk_1_k4vh.title: Tommon

wk_1_osgv.body:
A powerful narcotic colloquially said to launch the user to a high so powerful one feels like they are flying with Luuk. The especially spiritually attuned claim to be able to communicate with Luuk through symbolic visions while on the narcotic, though the vast majority of the Children of Luuk reject synthetic means of expressing faith in Luuk. Stranger still are unsubstantiated rumors of users teleporting small distances while on the substance, though these may be false reports intended to help sell product. The narcotic is produced by combining a crystallized form of ossite with a form of algae believed to have originated on Eden. The refinement process was discovered by Dorn chemists, and is the Dorn system's primary export. The most prominent side effect is the excretion of a saline suspension of bioluminescent algae through the tear ducts, leaving characteristic glowing streaks on user's faces.

By decree of High Priest Kaelor IX, consuming Ossite Tears is officially proscribed, and those claiming to commune with Luuk in this way are poorly disillusioned.
wk_1_osgv.title: Ossite Tears (Luuk's Flight)

wk_1_p1kr.body:
The strongest Fundamentalist voice within the church, Archbishop Sterno only narrowly lost out on ascending to becoming the High Priest due to an embarrassing public scandal at a party with Dorn elites. He manages the affairs of the church in all of Gorbulon space. 

His aspirations for power are large, and he is the only Archbishop who has not publicly denounced The Prophet.
wk_1_p1kr.title: Archbishop Sterno

wk_1_tfqq.body:
A statement issued by representatives of the 11th Fleet, the Bobursk Independent Militia (BIM), and the Cordage Reach Planetary Parliament (CRPP)

Star systems in the Zotov sector, particularly those outside of the immediate interest of Gorb, display the unfortunately common symptoms of crime--both organized and unorganized, moral degeneracy, and poverty prior to the arrival of the 11th Fleet. These systematic failings can be attributed to many reasons--worst of all being a complete loss of faith in the Empire itself. The recent liberation of Bobursk from the control of organized crime families serves as a prime example that positive change in these sectors can occur. It is therefore apparent that a strong, just governing authority with the full confidence of its peoples is needed to prevent backslide into such undesirable social conditions. 

It is not the interest of the 11th Fleet to have to spare resources amidst the prevalence of wider issues throughout the Zotov sector to directly administer such systems. In order to develop more robust planetary police, security, and militias capable of effectively cracking down on human trafficking, illegal arms, and the narcotics trade, the BIM and CRPP have reached a mutual security agreement that shall benefit all parties involved. 

The 11th Fleet will utilize its expertise and Imperial authority to take on the responsibility of training disciplined guardsmen, officers, and pilots from Bobursk and Cordage Reach from volunteers at select bases on Bobursk, New Fountain, and Imperial Garrison Station Zotov-9. 

All volunteers who pass the standard Imperial basic training course be rewarded with a Imperial Class I pension and access to the Imperial Core Worlds. Exceptional enlistees will have the opportunity to be fast-tracked into the ranks of the 11th Fleet and have access to Imperial Class II and Class III pensions depending on performance. 

In return, the BIM and CRPP shall begin the process of retrofitting and modernizing all spaceworthy vessels and starcraft for the purpose of planetary defense. These vessels will be crewed by a mixture of BIM, CRPP, and 11th fleet officers. These vessels will participate in patrols alongside the 11th Fleet vessels throughout the Zotov Sector to gain valuable organizational and combat experience. 

Signatures
Cmdr. Korebesky, 11th Fleet - Support and Training Staff, Imperial Garrison Station Zotov-9
Vice Adm. Petra, 11th Fleet - Wing A
Alexx Kimble, Governor of Bobursk, Leader of the Bobursk Independent Militia
Jonathan Ingslee, Lieutenant Governor of Bobursk
Filium Congle, First Minister of the Cordage Reach Planetary Parliament. 
Gerius Pond, President Pro Tempore of the Cordage Reach Planetary Parliament.
wk_1_tfqq.title: The Bobursk Accords

wk_1_vqpq.body:
My loyal subjects, 

Today is a day that shall live in infamy. Our former brethren on Flubb have taken up arms against Gorb. In their greed and desire for power, they have attempted to staunch the flow of Ossite to the Empire, wounding the lifeblood of our sector. Today, I announce officially that all members of the Flubbadite council who have mutinied will face the justice of Gorb. We will not allow these rogues to live a moment longer than they need to and we will stamp out all anti-Gorbulon activities present in our sector. With your help, we will drive this scourge out from our midst and make Zotov great again. 

His Eminence, 
Rightful Leader of the Zotov Sector, 
The Grand Marquis of Gorbulon
wk_1_vqpq.title: Official Gorbulon Response to the Secession of Flubb

wk_1_wye7.body:
Primag is mostly unremarkable world. its surface is covered by think jungle and it is sparsely inhabited. But floating it its low orbit is a massive trio of space stations that comprise one of the largest shipyards in the sector.

The Shipwright guild manages this installation, having purchased the rights to expand and administer it during a series of Imperial Austerity Sell offs. Back then it was a tiny outpost. Now it rival sthe shipyards of Hupp, New Fountain, and Bord.
wk_1_wye7.title: Primag

wk_1_xgh8.body: The CPS is one of the most important parts of the government of Gorbulon and is run by Garginox Grekky. Individual planets in Gorbulon space will always have a few garrisons of troops who are members of the CPS. The CPS act as local law enforcement and are responsible for creating safe and productive communities throughout the Zotov Sector. Gorbulons see the CPS as a point of pride and it is well-known that Gorbulon systems have little to no crime as a result of the unceasing efforts of the CPS. However, there are whispers that there are other, more sinister tasks that CPS is responsible for and it is not unheard of for dissidents to be whisked away in the middle of the night, never to be heard from again.
wk_1_xgh8.title: The Committee of Planetary Safety

wk_1_y57a.body: Apex predator of the Huppan jungle wilderness. These enormous reptiles possess mottled dusk-red skin, caustic venom, and a unique ability to mold their limbs into any desired form. This makes them incredibly deadly when striking from ambush, as they are known to climb into vertical foliage to dangle vine-like appendages capable of quietly injecting their venom into unsuspecting prey. When startled or provoked, they tend to form heavily muscled limbs capable of rending in twain even spacefleet steel. Fortunately for the human residents of Hupp, they are extremely territorial and do not often venture beyond the confines of the jungle. Braving the Huppan jungle wilderness requires remaining on constant alert to avoid becoming a Bastenich's meal. Slaying a Bastenich requires patience, the raw power of a modded shipyard exoskeleton, and a good deal of luck. To this day, Rongus Flub remains the only person to have ever killed one and returned with proof, but he paid a steep price for this victory. Samples of Bastenich venom and DNA retrieved by Rongus were entrusted to the care of the biology department at Huppsite University.
wk_1_y57a.title: The Bastenich

wk_20_7pkt.body:
Medvedev is a recent addition to the staff of the 11th fleet. He was a prodigy at the naval academy, but is untested in real combat. 

Some in the navy hoped his presence will be a moderating influence on the ambitious Zakar, as he is a member of a family close to the royal family in the galactic core.

Time will tell where his loyalties lie.
wk_20_7pkt.title: Captain Medvedev

wk_24_t6yh.body:
Each turn a check will be made for Each Ossite producing system.

on a 6+ the faction that controls that system will receive an Ossite surplus modifer.

```csv
Ossite Surplus
(Can be traded)
Can be spent to give a fleet an extra move.
```
wk_24_t6yh.title: Ossite Extraction

wk_2928_zsrc.body:
The Fubbadite Seat of power. The sectors second great ossite field, tapped only two generations ago. 

The world is fast becoming a metropolis utilizing the newest, most efficient extraction methods. it won't be long until it surpasses even Gorb at this rate
wk_2928_zsrc.title: Flubba

wk_2929_flgi.body:
The Homeworld of the Gorbulons and their political capital.

Ring-cities and clan citadels built over the sector's first and richest ossite fields. Opulent but visibly declining Towers stretch as far as the eye can see.
wk_2929_flgi.title: Gorb

wk_2931_diau.body: The largest world controlled by the Children of Luuk. Eden is vital to the faiths autonomy. While Luuk's rest is the spiritual home of the movement, it is a barren world incapable of supporting a large population. Eden on the other hand is lush and fertile. It is unusually bereft of Ossite for the region and is this unpolluted by the industry.
wk_2931_diau.title: Eden

wk_2941_ac4x.body:
The old power. For three hundred years the Gorbulon clans have ruled Zotov as the Empire's enfeoffed nobility. Gorbulons maintained a sprawling feudal hierarchy of vassal houses, tributary corporations, and indentured labor worlds, all owing fealty (and ossite) to the Gorbulon high seat on Gorb.

Not all is well for the sons of Gorb. Their once unstoppable fleet in the sector now gutted. Roughly 60% of Gorbulon capital ships were lost or crippled during the galactic civil war. What remains is old, undercrewed, and spread thin garrisoning ossite refineries. The Dominion compensates by leaning hard on vassal levies and mercenary contracts it can increasingly ill afford.

Gorbulon power is spread thin an vulnerable but when they can mobilize their vassal fleets they still command the most numerous Fleet in the sector.
wk_2941_ac4x.title: Gorbulons

wk_2942_9kue.body:
Once a cluster of minor mining tributaries, the Flubbadites are now the sector's rising industrial power. Their wealth was untouched by the worst of the Civil war, sitting on the second-largest ossite basin, and increasingly unwilling to pretend they still answer to Gorb.

Officially they are still Gorbulon tributaries. In reality they stockpile warships, cultivate Imperial court contacts of their own, and calculate exactly how long they can wait before the Gorbulons' weakness becomes undeniable enough to break the oath outright.

United in purpose, their smaller but more modern fleet punches above its weightclass in the sector. and unlike the Gorblulons or the Imperials they can fully rely on their forces loyalty
wk_2942_9kue.title: Flubbadites

wk_2944_zmy0.body:
The Children are refugees turned settlers. Descendants of the followers of the prophet Luuk, who led their ancestors to Zotov's outer worlds generations ago after exile from their homeworld in the imperial Core. They are the sector's oldest continuous population. There is no world in the sector without Luukite communities. 

The original Luukites made their home on Luuk's Rest and later, Eden. where they maintain an independent, though small, fleet.

The faith has existed mostly peacefully for hundreds of year on the edge of the sector. But there are murmurs of new radical prophets who may guide the Children down a different path.

Structurally, The Church is led by High Priest Kaelor IX, who ascended only very recently due to compromises between Modernists and Fundamentalists within the church. He is served by three Archbishops, who manage vast swaths of The Zotov Sector. Most sectors contain a local bishop and various other leaders, including Deacons (who sermonize and lead religious services) and Inquisitors.
wk_2944_zmy0.title: Children of Luuk

wk_2945_kjyp.body:
Nominally an Imperial garrison force. In practice, the only fully intact, first-rate battle-fleet in Zotov Sector, and the personal instrument of a commander with no intention of staying a policeman forever.

The 11th fleet has no history in the Zotov Sector and is free to enforce imperial will so long as the ossite continues to flow.

While officially under Imperial naval command. It is practically an autonomous military governorship personally loyal to Admiral Zakar. Admiral Zakar has spent three years quietly filling sector administrative posts with officers loyal to him personally rather than the Fleet chain of command, and cultivating the ossite-dependent Imperial bureaucracy back home as a source of leverage rather than orders.
wk_2945_kjyp.title: The 11th Fleet

wk_2_08no.body: Native to the Huppan jungles, these jet-black insects reproduce quickly and are voracious herbivores that make up one of the lowest links in the food chain on Hupp. Their populations are kept in check by the many predators who call the jungles home, but without this influence, Zankar locusts could strip the system of plant life in a matter of months.
wk_2_08no.title: Zankar Locusts

wk_2_3mti.body:
Galagon runs the [REDACTED]. He can be found [REDACTED]. 
The existence of Galagon is only known by a few. While it would be inaccurate to list him as the most feared member of the Inner Council, that is only true because nobody knows he exists. 
Galagon is primarily responsible for [REDACTED]. However, he also works quite closely with [REDACTED] since they both have a vested interest in [REDACTED].
wk_2_3mti.title: Galagon, the Observer

wk_2_3ugq.body: Little is known about the elusive Blanc F. Grizantine. It may be an alias, it may be a birth name, it may be a moniker for a collection of individuals operating under a collective false identity. What is known is that Blanc is in the business of operating a well-oiled machine that turns loosely defined directives from Phorbius and Kirinquaz into well-defined desired (and plausibly deniable) outcomes—and they are very, very good at their job.
wk_2_3ugq.title: Blanc F. Grizantine

wk_2_8nwa.body:
The Belt is a young star system where the matter in orbit has yet to condense into planets. 

These asteroids are extremely rich in, easy to access, valuable minerals that fuel many of of the shipyards in the sector. 

The Belt is managed by the Shipwright Guild on behalf of the Flubbadites.
wk_2_8nwa.title: The Belt

wk_2_bv6s.body:
Chief Communications officer of the 11th Fleet. He directs all formal intelligence-gathering campaigns for the fleet at large and reports to Admiral Zakar and the Imperial Council if needed. He served under Admiral Pushanka during the Civil War and was appointed to serve the 11th Fleet against Zakar's wishes due to his reduced loyalty to the admiral himself. 

He suspects Zakar has his own personal intelligence operative.
wk_2_bv6s.title: Lieutenant Hazan

wk_2_bxdc.body:
Paelin Zelt serves as Bishop of Cordage Reach, where she has long served to support and educate Luukite pilgrims following the Way to Sanctuary. A respected theologian and advocate for Modernist reform, she teaches that the spirit of Luuk's journey lies in interpersonal connections rather than rigid traditions. She has called for greater dialogue with neighboring powers and argues that the Church must interpret the Reliquary in light of an ever-changing galaxy.

Before his ascension, Kaelor IX studied under Bishop Zelt, and many credit her with shaping his early theology. In recent times, their relationship has soured as Kaelor's views shifted to fit the more popular moderate philosophies. Her written work on Luuk's teachings have been a powerful force for Modernist conversion.
wk_2_bxdc.title: Paelin Zelt, Bishop of Cordage Reach

wk_2_c5y6.body:
Rayne is a moderate Luukite and has ruled the Sanctuary system for the last 10 years. She has exercised an increased degree of independence from the church since the stand off at cordage reach.

It remains to be seen if the church will be able to restablish itself or if sanctuary will drift further.
wk_2_c5y6.title: Archbishop Rayne

wk_2_f73j.body: Though poor in ossite deposits, Jin is fabulously rich in an old resource covered by ancient empires prior to the dawn of space travel: oil. Oil is so plentiful that one could dig anywhere and they're likely to find a dark, greasy substance begin to fill the bottom of the hole. These seemingly unlimited petrochemical deposits are revered amongst chemists as high quality source material for complex chemical syntheses.
wk_2_f73j.title: Jin

wk_2_gdiu.body:
Gayson Gorn is the Proud, charismatic, and ambitious son of the late Duke of Dyne. He is embroiled in a civil war with his Aunt over control of the World.

Though outnumbered and outgunned, his allies have proven that they can fight tenaciously and have managed to halt the Invasion of the southern Continent for now.
wk_2_gdiu.title: Gayson Gorn

wk_2_havy.body: Grobbulus Gorbo was born on Jorbo and worked in its shipyards for many years as a newsboy and intermediary between local shipping companies. He eventually founded a news company that would ultimately blossom into the Voice of Gorbulon. A staunch Conservative and Gorbulon loyalist, he is convinced that, because he was able to pull himself up out of poverty and become one of the most influential members of Gorbulon society, there is no reason others cannot do the same and this vision is reflected by the Voice of Gorbulon. He is a member of the Inner Council and serves as the head of the Committee of Public Services. Grobbulus, like many of those on the Inner Council, is quite old and is looking for a successor to his media empire.
wk_2_havy.title: Grobbulus Gorbo

wk_2_k08l.body:
The 11th Fleet's top ace pilot during the Civil War, personally appointed to be in charge of the starfighter training academy at Zakar's Station. 

She personally invented the "Korbesky Maneuver" involving the use of overriding flight navigation computers to partially activate FTL drives, allowing the pilot to perform ridiculous, but sub-light, maneuvers while dogfighting. 

Admiral Zakar personally attributes at least 2 battle victories to Cmdr Korbesky. 

(Edits for grammar)
wk_2_k08l.title: Commander Korbesky

wk_2_n0re.body:
The Imperial Vessel Yakolev II was the former flagship of the Empire, having been sent to the Makovy sector prior to the onset of the Galactic Civil War as a show of force and a reminder to the rebels of Imperial power. Despite the military doctrine having already been shifted to carrier-based fleets, the Tunguska was an outdated legacy vessel boasting an impressive, but obsolete, armament of ship cannons and a paltry hangar for a ship of its size, much to the dismay of officers who had been pulled from other fleets and sectors to command this vessel. 

Zakar, at the time only a rear admiral, was stationed aboard the Yakolev serving Admiral Tunguska when the ship's Ossite reservoirs were mysteriously detonated, sparking the Makovy Crisis and the crackdown on suspected terrorists resulting in the civil war. While Admiral Tunguska and much of the Imperial fleet leadership beneath him were instantly vaporized, Zakar's body was found inexplicably alive within a barely pressurized hull fragment. His wounds were severe, with nearly the entire right half of his body charred and irrecoverable, but his mind remained lucid. Rumors circulated that Zakar was immune to anesthesia, resulting in him being wide awake throughout the entire 43 hour long surgery to tend to his wounds and install cybernetic limbs to replace those that he had lost.  

Once a soft-spoken, kindly officer who empathized greatly with the plight of oppressed people, Zakar left the recovery ward a changed man. His worldview shifted to one that despised anyone who couldn't be monitored and surveilled, particularly autonomous regions prone to degenerate and rebellious tendencies, like the Makovy sector.
wk_2_n0re.title: The Yakolev II Incident

wk_2_o8e6.body:
Nakimo's three suns tidally lock the planet into a perpetual ocean paradise. Settlements on the planet consist of manmade islands, the most luxurious and extravagant of which is simply known as "The Island". If you know about The Island, you know. 

As a result, Nakimo is the epicenter of Gorbulon-affiliated illict sex-trade and is responsible for 90% of all prostitutes servicing the dockworkers of Bord and the merchants of Yelftin. It's also a popular destination for "vacationers" as it's only a single jump gate away from both Gorb and New Fountain. 

Though somewhat of an odyssey, Gichael Gorbius makes the trip out to The Island at least once a year.
wk_2_o8e6.title: Nakimo

wk_2_pyjm.body:
Every four years, the Kronkite β-Ball Sector Grand Tournament is held in the Unka Stadium on Oasis and administered by the Kronkite β-Ball Grand Federation. After several fierce rounds of preliminary competition, the eight teams advancing to the elimination round(s) for this year's tournament are seeded as follows: 
1) Primag Photons
2) Gushky Glitches
3) The Angels of Ashfall 
4) Flubba Fleecers 
5) The Vixens of Vega Gate 
6) Gorb's Goons
7) The Gonzy Grapplers
8) Eden's Edict

While conventional sportscasters agree that the favorites to win it all are the Primag Photons, Eden's Edict has never made it to the playoffs before. This has led some to claim that Luuk's light will guide their team all the way to a championship title. Who's to say? May the best β-ballers win!

The matchups taking place during Turn 1 are as follows: 
Primag v Eden
Gushky v Gonzy
Ashfall v Gorb
Flubba v Vega Gate

Stay tuned to see who advances to the next round of the playoffs in Turn 2!!
wk_2_pyjm.title: Kronkite β-Ball Sector Grand Tournament

wk_2_vaq2.body:
Born to a working-middle class family on Primag, Juukwercker is arguably the best player to have ever strapped on Kronkite β-Ball grav boots. Though he's relatively new to the league, his pure athleticism is a sight to be seen. Without exaggeration, his efforts have made the Primag Photons the clear favorite to win this year's Sector Grand Tournament. 

In other words: Stank balls hard, and he's amassed a following of loyal fans excited to see the new heights he brings to the game. His hunger to always βe βallin' (his personal motto) is driven by his desire to provide his family with the means to provide the best possible medical care for his younger brother, who has a rare (and currently) incurable illness. 

And ladies....he's single ;)
wk_2_vaq2.title: Juukwercker Stank

wk_2_xfxb.body:
Dexation's civilization operates entirely on dexterity. Everything (and we really do mean everything) from the economy, to acquiring food/shelter, to social standing, to their language, is related to demonstrations of one's dexterity. Common means by which one's dexterity can be illustrated involve yo-yo tricks, tek-dek tricks, and shadow puppet shows, and communication is done exclusively through sign language. These rituals and customs make for much dexterity-related vexation (or dexation, ba-dum tss) for any outsiders who enter the system. It is unclear how these dexterity-related traditions came to be, and the single-minded devotion of the residents to their customs indicate a truly frightening and cult-like level of societal cohesion. 

Because the dexterity-related rituals and customs of the locals quite literally take a lifetime to master, it is virtually impossible for merchants to engage at a high enough level to convince the inhabitants to trade with them. As a result, millenia have passed with no economic exchange with the sector at large, and Dexation remains an extremely insular community that is inherently hostile to those who do not master its ways.
wk_2_xfxb.title: Dexation

wk_2_xyw3.body:
This dual star system hosts an enormous asteroid belt that make it easy for smaller vessels to avoid detection.

Pirates have made their home in the system for this reason.
wk_2_xyw3.title: The Twins

wk_2_zrtf.body:
Cities throughout the Zotov Sector are reeling as a coordinated strike of radical trade unionists have set off Narthex bombs at several Voice of Gorbulon broadcast stations. The use of Narthex has been banned for several decades, after an Imperial study determined that exposure to Narthex, an incredibly powerful pyrotechnic composition, caused rapid bone degeneration and internal bleeding.
While discrediting the Gorbulons is nothing new for so-called Flubbadite separatists, this is a new, dangerous low. If these radicals are willing to violate galactic law in order to kill journalists in the most cruel way possible, what other depravities are they willing to stoop to? 

Head of the Voice of Gorbulon, Grobbulus Gorbo responded for comment:

“What happened this day is a calamity that I have not seen in my lifetime. We have a duty to the citizens of Zotov Sector, no matter their political leanings, to deliver fair, free, and impartial news throughout our sector. Any attempt to violate this sacred compact is a frightening development but I have full faith in the Committee of Planetary Safety to bring these perpetrators to justice and to prosecute them to the fullest extent of the law. My heart bleeds for the families of these poor journalists and I pray that the actions of these violent criminals will not be unanswered.” 

Rebuilding efforts are already underway and the Voice of Gorbulon will continue its efforts to report on news throughout the Zotov Sector despite this tragedy. 

-Broadcast live from the Voice Of Gorb
wk_2_zrtf.title: Breaking News: Radicals Attempt to Narthex Bomb Voice of Gorbulon Broadcast Stations!

wk_32_xog0.body:
Turns will take about a week real time. A turn is roughly the in game time that it takes a Fleet to move to an Adjacent System.
Each Week you must submit orders moving your fleets (if you have any).
for players playing major factions I will expect moves every turn. Minor faction players do not need to worry about formal moves each turn. 

All other actions that you wish to take can be requested at any time. think of it like dungeons and dragons or any other GM moderated RPG. You specify what you are trying to do, then I will determine the difficulty of the task and make a hidden roll for the outcome. You can take as many or as few actions as you want in between turn cycles.

these include but are not limited to:
- Launching Bomber strikes
- Sending Agents to assassinate a rival
- Negotiating with NPCs
- Reorganizing your force's command chain
- Transferring Fighters between Carriers in the same system
- Investigate a conspiracy
- Launch a Coup
- Invade a Planet
- etc.
wk_32_xog0.title: Turn Structure

wk_34_uz5j.body:
The Marquis is the physical embodiment of the deteriorating Gorbulon fortunes.

The corpulent and decrepit Marquis has so far been able to keep the many Vassal houses under his thumb but the winds may be changing.

The Marquis Clings to the old way and will stop at nothing to see the rightful order restored.
wk_34_uz5j.title: The Grand Marquis Of Gorbulon

wk_35_lttr.body:
The House Of Dorn is a sworn vassal of Gorbulon. 

historically the Lords of Dorn maintain an iron grip on power through the rigid Dornish caste system. Laborers in the Ossite Fields live in such destitution that rebellion is thought to be impossible while the Dornish Lords in their ornate citadels are among the wealthiest individuals in the system.

The Source of the family''s power in recent years however comes from their Domination of the Sector's drug trade. Junkies and Zealots alike need their fix of the Green stuff
wk_35_lttr.title: The House of Dorn

wk_36_zrl5.body:
The House of Bord rules the crossroad between imperial space and Gorbulon space. 
Here they built many of the grandest starships the galaxy has ever seen, recent years have been tougher than the golden age but Bord still runs a very profitable shipbuilding industry.

For generations they have found a way to balance their loyalties and prevent conflict between these two giant from engulfing their neck of the sector.
But times are changing and now Gorb has called its vassal to a war will certainly bring imperial wrath down on Bord.
wk_36_zrl5.title: The House of Bord

wk_37_i54q.body: The Youngest Of the great Gorbulon Houses. The house of Vega does not descend from the Ancient Gorbulon Clans but are instead the descendants of the powerful merchant families that founded Vega Gate and built their wealth on the transport of Ossite rather than its extraction
wk_37_i54q.title: The House of Vega

wk_38_llid.body:
Cordage Reach had been disputed Gorbulon/Flubbadite territory for a generation. When a trade dispute erupted into gunfire three years ago, Admiral Zakar intervened with overwhelming force under the imperial flag. He crushed both sides, seized the system, and garrisoned it with 11th Fleet troops.

Then he stayed.

The Flubbadites saw what was happening and seized the moment. With Zakar's attention fixed on Cordage Reach and the Gorbulons distracted they stopped sending tribute to Gorb. The ossite taxes that had flowed offworld for centuries stopped, just like that. Flubba would Bow no longer

The Children of Luuk lost contact with the Sanctuary system. For generations pilgrims traveled through Cordage Reach on their way to and from the holy worlds. Now Imperial garrisons control the route and entry requires permissions Zakar is slow to grant. Communities that had been connected by faith became isolated overnight.

The Gorbulons objected loudly. The Grand Marquee demanded the system back, called it an Imperial overreach, and invoked ancient agreements. When Zakar ignored him, Gorb called its vassals to arms. Fleets were mobilized for the first time since the civil war. The Gorbulon clans would not fade into obscurity so easily.

The Powder Keg has been lit. There is no going back now.
wk_38_llid.title: The Standoff at Cordage Reach

wk_3_1qyv.body:
In light of recent events, and after careful consideration, the Grand Federation of Kronkite β-Ball has voted to continue with our plans to host the Sector Grand Tournament. The players in our leagues have trained endlessly to place themselves in the highest echelons of play in the sector, and it would be a devastation to their hopes and dreams to cancel the tournament. It is our hope that sport will remain a common language that succeeds in bringing the Zotov Sector together for entertainment in the form of the grandest game ever played. 

This year's tournament is a particularly exciting one, with a championship debut from rookie superstar Juukwercker Stank and the first ever appearance from Eden's Edict in a Tournament elimination round. We respectfully ask the sector to safeguard the precious sanctity of Kronkite β-Ball, for has a truer phrase than "βall is Life" ever been spoken? Tune into our coverage live, or make the pilgrimmage to the Luuk's Rest of Kronkite β-Ball in Unka Stadium on Oasis for an experience you'll never forget!

May the βest βallers win!
wk_3_1qyv.title: Official Statement from the Kronkite β-Ball Sector Grand Federation

wk_3_4wr6.body:
Dyne was once an unwavering ally to gorb. The planet's patriarchal society has fallen into a local civil war since the planet's Duke was killed in the galactic civil war along with the system's entirely fleet.

The potential heirs now vie for control in a war that covers much of the planet.

The Ossite deposits here are rich but the ongoing war makes export impossible.
wk_3_4wr6.title: Dyne

wk_3_4x9s.body:
The only populated body in Una is a small moon orbiting a gas giant. This moon is crisscrossed by giant fissures in the surface where many densely populated settlements are built into the bedrock. 
These structures and tunnel networks make for a very defensible series of natural citadels.
wk_3_4x9s.title: Una

wk_3_5yrk.body:
Raised as a devout Luukite, Kizavius Zakar first achieved notoriety as the first openly-practicing Luukite to become an officer in the Imperial navy. With his religion often the subject of scrutiny, Zakar, then only a Lieutenant, shaped his moderate and gentle doctrine around his beliefs and hoped his actions could soften Imperial prejudice toward other Luukites at large. 


The incident aboard the Yakolev II changed everything about him however. Once he was promoted to Admiral, Zakar abandoned his former faith and adopted a far more authoritarian view. While he once openly cherished his Luukite heritage, Zakar has now lumped in the religion as another rogue element outside of direct Imperial control, a belief exacerbated by his awareness of radical factions and sectarian violence brewing within Luukism at large.
wk_3_5yrk.title: Zakar's Luukite Origins

wk_3_b0im.body:
Her mother died giving birth to her younger brother Phorbius when she was only eight years old. Her father Pargulon's infamous hunting accident resulted in her becoming virtually orphaned at the age of sixteen. Though Rongus took Kirinquaz and Phorbius under his wing, Kirinquaz was old enough at the time of the incident to know Rongus to be a surrogate who could never truly replace the hole left in her heart left by her beloved father. At the same time, she is grateful for his support in raising Phorbius and holding their family together. 

Though she dotes on her younger brother, they could not be more dissimilar in temperament. Where Phorbius is kind, Kirinquaz is abrasive. Where he is patient, she is irascible. If Phorbius's empathy has enabled him to see paths to replacing the old traditions with something more closely resembling a meritocracy, Kirinquaz's stubbornness has enabled her to persevere through to solutions to some of the most challenging engineering problems of the ossite refinement processs. Though her ingenuity has enabled the Flubbadite naval modernization that has helped propell Phorbius to his place at the head of the council, she has little interest in politics. She's content to tinker, support her younger brother, and search for a solution to her father's condition. She, more than anyone else, refuses to give up on Pargulon. Though, in recent years she's been compelled to look for a cure in areas more...spiritual than scientific.
wk_3_b0im.title: Kirinquaz Gloch

wk_3_ppvc.body:
Midway through Luuk's pilgrimmage through the stars, he and his followers discovered a world of verdant plains, rolling hills, and placid lakes. Enamored by the creature comforts of a benevolent world whose natives had not yet discovered spaceflight, many of Luuk's followers decided to settle and set down roots. A year or two after Luuk and the remainder of his Faithful departed, terrible warships appeared on the horizon, laying waste to the world. Though the surface of the world is uninhabitable and the atmosphere has been plunged into indefinite nuclear winter, the Children of Luuk lament the loss of their Brethren and declared the world a holy gravesite for their departed. In the present era, the most devout followers of the faith will ask for the privilege of having their ashes ejected into Vigil's atmosphere. 

Some followers of the Rogue Prophet say that Luuk himself orchestrated "The Glassing of Vigil" due to blind rage over the departure of many of his faithful for greener pastures.
wk_3_ppvc.title: Vigil

wk_3_ss8x.body: Veteran of the Makovy Rebellion and childhood friend of Rongus Flub, Admiral Crunkis is the steadfast, street-smart hand guiding any Flubbadite military action. A former gang member, he owes a lifelong debt to Rongus for providing him with the opportunity to escape the cycle of violence he found himself enmired in. Rongus was able to use his connection to Pargulon to appoint Janovy in a military position, where Janovy ultimately excelled and steadily climbed the ranks. After Phorbius gained prominence, he was invited to serve as the primary military advisor/atachè to the Flubbadite Council, where he has faithfully served ever since.
wk_3_ss8x.title: Admiral Janovy Crunkis

wk_3_uebl.body:
A competent tactician, though his experience largely came from skirmishes toward the end of the Civil War. He typically serves under Vice Admiral Petra's direct command aboard his vessels. 

Lukas is one of the few Luukites serving in the 11th fleet. His presence is at best tolerated by Zakar, though it may change depending on his performance. 

He is painfully aware that he must balance his career with his personal beliefs.
wk_3_uebl.title: Captain Lukas

wk_3_whsg.body: Hedonistic, airheaded, and ostentatious—Gichael is Gorbulon's most prominent boyfailure and the Dorn family's patriarch. While previous generations of House Dorn amassed their fortune through the production of Luuk's Flight for profit and forbade personal recreational use, Gichael never saw a reason to abstain. He has abdicated his responsibilities by floating away on a cloud of synthetic with his veritable army of concubines. His many illegitimate children are a constant source of embarrassment for the other members of House Dorn, and his lavish lifestyle is a symbol of the direction of Gorbulon at large.
wk_3_whsg.title: Gichael Gorbius

wk_3_xj40.body: Garginox Grekky chairs the Committee of Planetary Safety and is another key member of the Gorbulon Inner Council. Garginox grew up on Dorn and is the scion of a well-respected military family. He has long been a proponent of bringing the Dornish caste system to the rest of the Zotov Sector and has attempted to push this through at council meetings but it has never gotten the votes required to pass. Garginox is not the most widely respected figure on the Inner Council because many think him to be rash and brutish. However, he has an eye for tactics and has lots of experience bringing rebellions to heel.
wk_3_xj40.title: Garginox Grekky

wk_47_at88.body:
System nodes of the Map represent large local star clusters. They tend to be named for the most significant settlement in them but a fleet that is "In the Oasis System" may in reality be orbiting a different star in its near vicinity. thus engagements between carriers can happen across solar systems with strike craft ftl jumping between various stars to pursue or evade other strike craft.

This also makes tools like radar near useless for detecting enemy carriers, as they can be light-years away, scouting craft need to jump to systems and positively ID enemy ships.

One consequence of this its that Missions are "fire and forget" you will not be in contact with your pilots via radio and strike craft are not large enough to launch or skiffs back to their parent craft. once your squadrons jump away, you will lose contact with them until they return
wk_47_at88.title: Systems and Abstraction of Space

wk_49_tmdb.body:
Since the Death Gaffer Gorn, the old lord of Dyne, His son and sister have waged a war for control of the planet. 

The advantage was thought to lie entirely with the dead lord's sister, Gertrude Gorn, the commander of the Dyne Defense force. Gaffer's Son Gason Gorn, has manged to rally a coalition of allies together and cling on to power in the south.

In the first months of the war Gertrude consolidated power on the northern continent and pushed her nephew's forces to the southern continent. her invasion of the southern continent has dragged into a stalemate with unmoving front line and unbelievable carnage.

Both Leaders are staunch Gorbulon conservatives but would maybe be willing to make concessions for a way to break the stalemate

The war has now turned decisively in favor Gertrude since the battle of Yondo.
wk_49_tmdb.title: The War For Dyne

wk_4_c127.body: A mysterious figure rarely seen in public. They are widely believed to be the clerical agent responsible for exterminating all extra-canonical interpretations of the faith. Less widely known is that Jelzik was raised among Flubbite aristocracy before he absconded to the faith, the reason for which neither the Church nor the Flubbites have ever publicly addressed.
wk_4_c127.title: Waywarden Jelzik, High Inquistor

wk_4_gocj.body:
Tucked away in the far corner of galaxy, the Edge is not even on many imperial maps. It is a world of little importance, occupied by pioneers, prospectors, pilgrims, and exiles.

But this tiny world may not remain obscure for long. There are stories of miracles, magic, and an enigmatic preacher that has amassed a following of believers at an alarming rate.
wk_4_gocj.title: The Edge

wk_4_h96a.body:
The Royal Pulmonologist. Gobb has the crucial and challenging job of keeping the Marquis breathing. whatever the cost.
Few individuals have such unfettered access to the Grand Marquis.
wk_4_h96a.title: Gilman Gobb

wk_4_lj5u.body:
To the laborers in the shipyards, the ossite miners of the crystal fields, the refiners. To the engineers, the builders, the workers. Long have you been the foundation of the empire, the very backbone, the spine itself! Without your efforts, the production of ossite would grind to a halt, and the ships that consume it would never emerge from the cradle of the shipyard. For generations, what has been our reward? The Gorbulons have skimmed from the raw output of our efforts, swelling like a tick on the jugular of the industrious Flubbadite stallion. 

No longer! We know better than anyone that the path forward will require grit, determination, and the vision to see us through the turbulence. But once Gorbulon sees the folly of their ways and allows Flubba to spread it's wings, Flubbadites will usher in an age of prosperity never before seen in the Zotov Sector. The Gorbulons would do well to emulate our industriousness—and to remember that the only "Rightful Leader" of the Zotov Sector is Emperor Yakolev himself. The ossite tributes will continue to flow—the stream has simply been diverted from the fetid Gorbulonic swamp. 

In solidarity, 

Phorbius Flub
Chair of the Flubbadite Council
wk_4_lj5u.title: An Announcement From the Flubbadite Council

wk_4_n0gj.body: A sparsely populated star system consisting only of gas giants. Their moons are the only places with any settlements despite the constant volcanism from tidal forces. The sector's primary industry is space whale hunting and processing of its products as a low-grade fuel for commercial and residential use.
wk_4_n0gj.title: Tellum

wk_4_nbwa.body:
This is the only system in the Zotov sector, and one of only three in the entire galaxy, that orbits a black hole. Only the crumbled remnants of ancient planets remain after the star that once sat at the center of this system erupted in a massive supernova millions of years ago. The intrinsic chaos of this system makes it treacherous for novice pilots as asteroids are very often flung out toward ships at seemingly random intervals. 

Still, numerous asteroid mining bases have popped up along the perimeter of this system. Ossite reserves here are mostly depleted, but the system is still rich in other minerals sought after in the galactic core worlds.
wk_4_nbwa.title: Rodin

wk_4_s32b.body: Commander of the Dyne Defense Force and sister to the late Duke of Dyne, Gertrude Has made a play for planetary control. She ousted her nephew from the royal court and now is engaged in a protracted campaign to root him out of his stronghold on the southern continent.
wk_4_s32b.title: Gertrude Gorn

wk_5_2nzr.body: The construction of the Yelflin jump gate by the Gorbulons completely sidelined this backwater sector into irrelevancy. Once the seat of powerful trade guilds and bustling cities have largely decayed into violent turf wars and crumbling, gilded ruins. Crime is rampant, piracy is the norm. Off-system travelers are not advised to visit any planets in this system. Travelers are not advised to visit this system, period.
wk_5_2nzr.title: Dust

wk_5_82ma.body: Grizyölenda is Gichael's eldest child and the presumptive heir to the fortune and mantle of House Dorn. Before the voluminous tide of Gichael's loins demonstrated to Gichelle the futility of attempting to hide her husband's illegitimate offspring from the public eye, Gichelle shipped Grizyölenda off to private boarding school on the Gorbulon home world where she was raised by the finest tutors money could buy. There, she became childhood friends with Gorbin Glu and discovered a natural talent for chemistry that has been further cultivated through study at the prestigious Gorbulonic Institute of Technology. Upon her return to Dorn, she put her prodigious talent at work in service of the family business. wk_78_x512.body:
In the deep Dark of space Carrier fleets armed with swarms of capable strike craft are King. Using targeted ftl jumps, squadrons can arrive, launch their ordinance and jump to safety from a much greater range that any heavy capital ship cannon. So all capital ships except Carriers have become obsolete.

The decisive currency of carrier combat is not armor or firepower but time. The minutes between launch, strike, and recovery are the difference between life and death. A carrier's true vulnerability is the empty hangar. Caught with its wings deployed and its magazines open, a carrier is little more than a coffin with engines. A wise Admiral employs deep scouting Missions, screening escorts, staggered launch cycles, and a healthy reserve squadron to avoid disaster.

Carrier operation really boils down to managing a series of overlapping time tables, launch, recover, fuel, rearm, Not all of these things can be done simultaneously. Meticulous timetables must be kept to keep squadrons operating at full capacity. If you are operating at 100% theoretical capacity, ie, as soon as you launch one wing of fighters you immediately recover another, you will be vulnerable to any minor interruption, be it from hostile attacks or from simple accidents and you will likely have to mass ditch the wings cant be recovered. This is Why buffer times are usually built into Carrier operation cycles but in an emergency may be overridden.

These massive Vessels take years to build and cost a fortune that only the most powerful can afford. Strike craft are less prohibitively expensive and, along with their pilots, can be treated by a callous admiral as an extendible resource. A Captain that destroys an enemy carrier while taking 90% casualties to his bomber wing can correctly, if cruelly, claim a decisive victory.

Ftl jumps are not nearly precise enough to target individual ships or even planets. When you ftl jump tiny differences in starting conditions that are unpredictable butterfly out into enormous margins of error. Your actual arrival coords and targeted destination are off by multiple AUs and conventional drives must be used to arrive at the desired destination
wk_78_x512.title: Naval Combat in the Zotov Sector

"Mission Success Shifts" (MSS) can be applied by other factors including but not limited to ship quality, environmental hazards, veteran pilots, surprise attacks etc.
The same is true for "Casualty Shifts" (CS)
A combat shift means that the column referenced for a roll is "shifted" to the left or the right by one column.

the shorthand for shifts is type+/-amount.
Mission success shift 2 to the right: MSS+2
casualty shift 1 to the left: CS-1

Example: you attack an enemy carrier with 32 bombers, the carrier is defended by 12 fighters. the baseline force ratio is 32/13=2.48 rounded to the nearest ratio column, in this case 2.5.
you roll a 7
then we apply shifts.
your squads are piloted by seasoned veterans and so you receive a +1 mission success shift meaning you get your success core from the 3/1 column
the defending ship has advanced anti-squadron flak cannons so you get a -2 casualty shift meaning you take casualties from the 1.5/1 column
Your final result is 4/5 mission result and 40% casualties.

wk_7_8ycp.body:
The elder Gloch, who was once appointed to represent the interests of the entire planet of Hupp as a Fluppadite councilor, has tragically lain in a cryo-coma for the better part of a half-century. In his free time, his primary hobby was to venture into the Huppan wilderness to conquer it's exotic game. His trophy room was once the envy of the system, and tales of his courage and lethal skill made him a revered figure amongst the softer, pampered appointees of yesteryear's Flubbadite council. 

Alas, hardy adventurers like Pargulon rarely die in their sleep—on his final trip into the jungles of Hupp, he had a fatal encounter with a Bastenich. The only reason Pargulon doesn't occupy the space beneath a marble headstone is due to the quick thinking of his companion Rongus Flub, who managed to slay the beast and bring Pargulon to Huppsite University's hospital before the venom could claim his life. Even then, the exotic nature of Bastenich venom meant that doctors could only place Pargulon into cryo-coma until an antivenom could be synthesized. 

A half-century later, the academic community has largely given up—every day that draws by increases the likelihood that Pargulon will never wake. But, a part of Pargulon lives on in through his two children, his son Phorbius and his daughter Kirinquaz.
wk_7_8ycp.title: Pargulon Gloch

wk_8_1lrw.body:
Prince of the flubbadite, The Great Reformer. Phorbius sits at the head of the flubbadite council and is the force behind its naval modernization effort.
Under the guide of Phorbius, the Flubbadite council has seen the greatest culture shift in its history. Gone are the old family appointees and in are a new group of young, ambitious, radical leaders. 

Phorbius's unique upbringing as the scion of the Gloch family tempered through the lens of Rongus Flub's experiences as a caretaker left him with a perspective on Flubbadite society that virtually no aristocrat in all of history has held—namely that a community is only as prosperous as it's least prosperous elements. It would have been easy for Phorbius to allow himself to be molded by the council of at-will political appointees, and easier still to flame out in his attempt to alter the trajectory of Flubbadite institutional inertia. 

Instead, after decades of maneuvering, patience, and steady advances, Phorbius finds himself the head of Flubbadite's council after heralding in an age of Flubbadite prosperity on the backs of the twin pillars of his sister Kirinquaz's ingenuity and his own commitment to ensuring the highest possible material living conditions and class mobility in the Zotov Sector to all members of Flubbadite society. Naturally, this has won him immense animosity from conservative Flubbadite councilors reluctant to relinquish their power and potential for lopsided wealth generation, but it is difficult for them to argue with the results of his efforts. On the flipside, his support for the working class has won him powerful allies in the Shipwright union, enabling him to double the Flubbadite fleet and triple their economic output over the span of a roughly thirty year period.
wk_8_1lrw.title: Phorbius Flub

wk_8_271d.body:
Guild workers are employed in every major shipyard in the sector save a few Gorbulon systems.

At its founding the guild was little more than an industrial Trade Union, but the Sector's hunger for warships has given the guild unprecedented leverage to expand its power. It now operates whole systems semi-autonomously.

Historically the Guild's influence in most of the Zotov Sector was moderated by Gorbulon Decree Banning Guild members from their Shipyards. 

It has formed a mutually beneficial alliance with the Flubbadite Council, and churns out modern naval vessels at rates not yet seen in the Zotov sector.
wk_8_271d.title: The Shipwright Guild

Elders on both sides thought they could manipulate this young leader to suit their goals. That all changed when The High Priest Discovered relics thought long lost of Luuk's Rest.

The humble career priest who was supposed to be a moderate, sycophantic figurehead has turned out to be the most dynamic and ambitious leader the faith has seen in years.
wk_8_pqrr.title: High Priest Kaelor IX

wk_8_tmds.body:
When a specific character or characters want to travel to different system they can take small personal sized draft that are difficult to intercept.

Movement Rules for these characters are as follows.

The base move speed of a personal transport is 3. that means it can move up to 3 systems in a chain. This can be increased by 1 up to 4 if starting in a jump gate.

This is because, unlike carriers, these craft have no combat potential and can always be considered to be "overloading their engines". in addition the amount of ossite surplus it takes to boost this move even further is trivial for such a small vessel.

further ossite surplus cannot be used to increase this movement.

It always takes at least 1 turn to ftl jump across systems, even if you only need to go fewer than 3 systems distance.
